jobs.title: Director and Practice Lead, Data Engineering
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital agency and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across: Digital Product Strategy & Innovation, Digital Marketing Services, Web & Mobile App Development, Data & AI, Cloud Engineering, and Enterprise Technology Modernization.

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

Location & Flexibility

Our Director & Practice Lead, Data Engineering
will operate remotely in Canada OR be based out of either our Toronto, ON or Vancouver, BC office locations.

The Opportunity

TELUS Digital's Data, AI & Cloud (DAIC) practice is the multidisciplinary engine behind enterprise AI, blending boutique innovation with the breadth of a global services portfolio to help organizations architect, scale, and secure their transformations. Spanning our full family of specialized capabilities, the DAIC practice delivers end-to-end solutions across AI Advisory, AI Solutions, Data & AI Platforms, and Cloud Transformation.

As a premier Google Cloud partner, our Cloud practice is at the forefront of helping enterprises adopt and scale on Google Cloud infrastructure: delivering complex engineering, deployment, and migration programs for some of the largest organizations in Canada and beyond.

The Director & Practice Lead, Data Engineering
will define and own the Data Engineering Practice along with its market positioning, P&L, talent, and the quality of work we deliver for clients. This role is for someone who has led data and AI practices before, understands how to turn messy enterprise data estates into strategic assets, and earns trust with C-suite executives through genuine expertise. You will shape how we help clients move from data ambition to durable, AI-ready infrastructure.

This Role Will Have Four Core Anchor Responsibilities

Strategy: Set the practice vision and align Data & AI capabilities to where enterprise demand is heading.
P&L: Own revenue targets, margin, and growth while being accountable for the practice's full commercial performance.
Talent & Culture: Build a practice where data-driven thinking, innovation, and engineering rigour are the baseline.
Client Impact: Act as a trusted advisor to enterprise CxOs navigating data strategy, AI adoption, and governance.

Responsibilities

Define the multi-year vision for the Data Engineering Practice, ensuring our technical capabilities are ahead of the curve for enterprise demand for Data & AI transformation.
Own the full P&L, including pipeline, pricing, delivery margin, and revenue growth, while reporting directly to executive leadership with clear commercial accountability.
Build and sustain senior relationships with Google Cloud partner teams and client executives to generate meaningful deal flow and expand strategic accounts.
Lead the practice's position on ethical AI and data democratisation while making principled, evidence-based bets on where advanced analytics and AI are creating real enterprise value.
Drive investment in reusable IP, data accelerators, and delivery assets that improve consistency, reduce time-to-value, and protect margins at scale.
Serve as a strategic advisor to client C-suite executives, helping them define data strategy, navigate AI adoption, and build the organisational capabilities to sustain it.
Set the standard for engineering and analytical excellence across the practice by hiring well, developing talent deliberately, and building teams that clients trust and return to.

Competencies

12+ years in data or AI consulting, including at least 3–5 years in a practice leadership or executive role, not just senior delivery or individual contribution.
Proven P&L ownership: Direct experience managing revenue, margin, and growth targets in a consulting or professional services context.
Data and AI ecosystem depth: Strong command of modern data architecture, AI, and ML trends, cloud-native data platforms, and enterprise data governance.
Executive communication: Able to advise, challenge, and build lasting trust with C-suite stakeholders on complex, ambiguous problems, not just present to them.
Business Development track record: Experience generating pipeline and closing complex, multi-stakeholder engagements, not just managing delivery once work is sold.
Talent leadership: Has hired, grown, and retained senior data engineering and consulting talent in a practice or delivery organisation.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing that information with us.

For more information on how we use your information, see our Privacy Policy.

Compensation Range: CA$211K - CA$302K

jobs.title: Director, Insights & Measurement
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Plus Company Media, we thrive at the crossroads of creativity, strategy, and innovation. As part of a global network of 26 agencies, we connect brilliant talent with iconic brands to craft media solutions that spark conversations and deliver results. Our collaborative energy fuels bold ideas, empowers growth, and ensures we stay ahead in an ever-evolving media landscape. Working with us means tapping into a vibrant ecosystem where your expertise shines brighter and your impact reaches further.

Transparency matters to us.
For this role, you can expect a salary between $105,000-$150,000 annually, depending on experience. This is for a new vacancy.

Role Description

As the Director, Insights & Measurement
, you will be the primary analytical mind and strategic architect behind our advanced media attribution, experimentation, and business science methodologies. This role is designed for a heavyweight statistician and media measurement expert who thrives on solving the "what worked and why" for major brands.

While you will collaborate closely with our dedicated internal Data Engineering and Infrastructure teams—who build and maintain our cloud pipelines—you will own the frameworks, model designs, and causal inference methodologies. You will act as a senior leader, serving as the crucial bridge who translates complex statistical outputs (like MMM, MTA, and lift studies) into high-level strategic narratives and multi-million-dollar budget optimization recommendations for modern CMOs and CFOs.

Location: Toronto
Core Focus: 70% Attribution Methodology & Experimental Design; 30% Client Consulting, Narrative Strategy & Team Mentorship.

Key Responsibilities
Advanced Attribution & Econometric Modeling

Methodology Ownership: Lead the theoretical design, validation of custom Marketing Mix Models (MMM), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), and customer Path-to-Conversion frameworks.
Unified Measurement Strategy: Champion a "Unified Measurement" approach, combining macro-level MMM econometric trends with micro-level digital attribution signals to give clients a singular source of truth.
Advanced Feature Engineering & Design: Determine the data requirements, adstock transformations, and saturation curve variables needed for accurate modelling, directing data engineers on how to prepare these schemas.

Experimentation & Causal Inference

Testing Frameworks: Architect randomized control trials (RCTs), matched-market tests, and geo-lift studies to establish true incrementality and validate marketing models.
Model Calibration: Use test-and-learn results and lift studies to continuously calibrate and ground MMM/MTA models, stripping out correlation and proving true causal media ROI.

Client Consulting & Strategic Storytelling

Strategic Translation: Turn highly complex mathematical outputs, coefficient shifts, and statistical variances into clear, visual, and highly compelling business recommendations.
Budget Optimization: Guide clients on optimal media mix scenarios, flighting strategies, and cross-channel budget reallocations based on model predictions.
New Business & Growth: Serve as the measurement subject matter expert during high-profile agency pitches, articulating our advanced attribution capabilities to prospective client stakeholders.
Team Mentorship: Direct and mentor a growing team of media analysts and marketing scientists, cultivating deep methodological expertise and client-ready presentation skills.

Qualifications & Requirements Experience

6+ years of professional experience in marketing science, econometrics, data science, or advanced media analytics.
3+ years of experience specifically focused on designing and running attribution models (MMM/MTA) and designing lift/incrementality experiments.
Strongly Preferred: Direct experience working within a Media Agency, AdTech firm, or marketing consultancy.

What’s in it for you:

We Value The ‘whole You’

An innovative and entrepreneurial work environment that promotes ingenuity and individuality - with the best of colleagues, and the best of clients
Hybrid work models and flexible hours, plus a work from anywhere policy for short-term stays in other regions
Generous Vacation starting at 3 weeks + 1 extra week over the holidays
Agency summer days (exact policy differs per campus and agency)
Modern, open co-working spaces with coffee & snack bars, located in great city neighborhoods, close to shops and restaurants and easy access to public transport
Dogs allowed, dedicated Play Room to support families and Private wellness room (in select offices)
Team social events - holiday parties, seasonal gatherings, weekly happy hours, inspiring speakers and more!

We are obsessed with learning and being better humans

In-house learning & development sessions and annual career and growth conversations’
Access to internal network of opportunities across all agencies
Internal EDI group(s), programs & initiatives across Plus Company and opportunities to be involved in employee resource group(s)

Check out our EDI report here to learn more about our work and commitment towards equity.

We invest in your health and wellness:

Flexible benefits to support your individual lifestyle and life stage – with access to a personal wellness spending account you can use for a wide range of wellness expenses, including gym membership fees, pet care, education expenses, and much more!
Comprehensive mental health support including access to a virtual mental health therapy clinic providing you with personalized therapist guided iCBT programs and live therapy, access to health clinicians 24/7, and a holistic array of other health and wellness resources to support you and your family.
Dedicated play rooms for days you need to bring the kids and health and wellness rooms when you need a place to get grounded.
A responsible sick & personal absence days policy designed so you don't have to worry the moment a personal obligation or emergency arises.
Maternity leave top up program.

Expiry Date Notice: This job description expires on (11/20/26)

We’re humbled by the number of talented people who apply to work with us every day. And, we thank each and every one of you. Truly. We’ll reach out directly to those we’d like to meet for an interview.

To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation for all candidates, our interviewers are supported by an AI tool that securely takes notes during the conversation

Creating meaningful work means embracing different perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on age, colour, ability, national origin, race, religion, sex, or sexual orientation. Not only are these provisions protected by provincial and federal law, embracing difference is what makes Plus Company what it is—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. We pride ourselves on our inclusive and accessible workplace. If you need any accommodations during the interview process to make it work for you, let us know.

By joining Plus Company, you become part of a unique partnership of forward-thinking creative agencies. As a network, we unabashedly believe anything is possible. Why? Because possibility is what powers the big dreams and limitless drive of an entrepreneur. And entrepreneurial agencies are what we’re made of. A whole network of them.

jobs.description:
Your Partners in Recruitment!

Thorek/Scott and Partners (TSP) has been connecting accomplished organizations with talented individuals for almost four decades. At TSP, our track record of successfully completing challenging searches across the professional spectrum has earned us an exceptional reputation at the forefront of the recruitment industry. Our Canadian and International clients include: global banks and non-bank financial institutions, private equity and investment funds, professional service firms, and entrepreneurial businesses in a variety of industries. We value the human connection and distinguish ourselves through an unwavering dedication to understanding the goals and motivations of our clients and candidates alike.

This open role is currently being featured by Thorek/Scott and Partners! We highlight a variety of open roles every week. If you save this position to apply to later, it may appear closed when you revisit it. For a full list of all open positions, please visit www.thorekscott.com.

Position Overview

Our client is a highly successful Canadian asset management firm with an expansive global and national platform. The firm invests in a variety of long-lived asset classes through a growing portfolio of private funds and publicly listed operating entities.

They are currently seeking a Vice President, Finance to lead a growing team focused on their private investments strategy. Reporting to the SVP, the VP will drive investment finance and reporting for a set of large and complex existing and emerging funds. The role is highly visible, with extensive cross-functional interaction with senior executives and a range of complex challenges. Experience in a complex, substantive fund environment is essential for success in this role.

This is an attractive opportunity for a seasoned CPA with extensive fund operations leadership to make their mark in a growth-oriented investor with significant upward mobility.

Role Responsibilities

Own the overall fund strategy and lead finance and operations teams.
Interpret fund results, anticipate financial and operational risks, and present quarterly results and recommendations to senior management.
Oversee fund liquidity, cash flow forecasting, capital calls, investor distributions and fund-level compliance.
Review quarterly investor reporting under US GAAP Investment Company Accounting and IFRS, including financial statements, partners’ capital statements and remaining commitment schedules. Review fund valuations and entity-level financial reporting.
Maintain effective internal controls and audit readiness, and oversee the accuracy and timeliness of work performed by external service providers.
Serve as the senior finance partner to Investments, Investor Relations, Tax, Legal, Treasury and Portfolio Management. Advise on complex accounting issues, fund structures and new acquisitions.
Develop the fund finance team and improve reporting, systems and processes as the platform grows, including through the use of AI and other emerging technologies.
Respond to investor inquiries on fund performance, reporting and capital activity.
Review legal-entity accounting packages, including tax financials.
Assess how fund legal structures affect the movement of cash between entities and the consolidation of financial results.

Desired Qualifications

At least 10 years of progressive experience in finance and/or accounting, with hands-on fund experience. Private funds experience, investment management industry knowledge and exposure to complex ownership structures are assets.
University degree and a professional accounting designation (CPA/CA or equivalent).
Strong technical accounting expertise in US GAAP Investment Company Accounting and IFRS, with experience reviewing investor reporting, fund valuations and complex consolidations.
Experience overseeing fund operations, including liquidity management, forecasting, capital calls, investor distributions and fund-level compliance.
Demonstrated leadership and initiative, with the ability to develop finance teams, improve processes and partner with senior stakeholders across Investments, Investor Relations, Tax, Legal and Treasury.
Experience overseeing external service providers and working with auditors to maintain effective internal controls and audit readiness.
Strong financial systems skills, including advanced Excel. Experience with Mercatus, Workiva or Anaplan is an asset.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational and communication skills, with the judgment to anticipate risks and advise senior management.
Proactive and accountable, with the ability to manage competing priorities, adapt quickly and meet deadlines in a complex, fast-paced environment.

Please note that at present, legal eligibility to work in Canada is a prerequisite for this role.

jobs.title: Head of Communications, Brand & Digital Marketing
jobs.description:
Why Arup?

At Arup we’re dedicated to shaping a better world. Our purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for over 80 years. We solve the world's most complex problems and deliver what seems impossible, with curiosity and creativity. We’re a thriving and growing organization which offers you many possibilities to shape a better world, and your future.

In an increasingly competitive marketplace, our Marketing, Communications, and Business Development (MCBD) team enables Arup to build and protect our reputation, deepen client relationships, win quality work, and attract top talent. This role will be key in achieving strategic market and client ambitions. We are seeking to appoint a Head of Communications, Brand & Digital Marketing - Americas Region t o join our MCBD function.

What This Role Involves

The Head of Communications, Brand & Digital Marketing - Americas Region plays a central role in leading the development and implementation of Arup’s regional communications plan enhancing, protecting Arup’s brand and reputation, and guiding the evolution of our digital footprint, ensuring alignment with our strategy and the business priorities defined in our integrated business plan.

The role leads the regional Communications, Brand & Digital Marketing teams and ensures positive work sharing, ensuring efficiency and effectiveness of our resources supporting region and global priorities . They also work closely with the Regional Leadership: including the Managing Director, the Business and Markets Leader, MCBD Leader, Global Communications Leaders and Legal Counsel ensuring cohesive and effective delivery of content and campaigns that elevate the brand.

Team Leadership

Manage a regional team of digital marketers, brand and creatives, and communications professionals, providing alignment with global marketing and communications programs, and ensures that regional content and campaigns support broader firm initiative.
Collaborates with and advises Global Strategic Marketing and Communications providing a regional perspective on content, campaigns and programs .
Partners closely with regional leadership championing a business partner mindset across the team.
Ensures the team and its programs are high-performing and continually improving to meet the changing needs of the market.
Builds, mentors, and leads a high-performing team providing performance management and career development advice, as well as ongoing training and development opportunities to team members.
Foster a collaborative, inclusive and innovative team culture.
Champions connectivity and collaboration across the MCBD team, enabling joint working, resource flexibility and sharing better practice and learnings.
Develops and manage regional brand, digital marketing and communications budget, including allocation of resources and spend to optimize ROI.

Communications Strategy, Planning and Management

Provides strategic communications advice to Arup’s regional leadership team, and oversees the development and implementation of leadership communications across internal and external channels.
Leads the development of the regional communications plan (internal and external communications) in collaboration with Regional and Geography Leadership and working closely with other MCBD Region Leaders.
Apply insights gained from trends in communications, in particular changes in audience behaviour and use of technology, to identify opportunities to update our communications strategy and plans.
In consultation with Americas Legal Counsel Oversees, leads the regional crisis communications program.
Regularly reports on communications programs and monitors and assesses implementation of the communications plan and adjust as needed to achieve the region’s objectives.

Brand & Visual Communications

Leads the development of creative and content solutions required for marketing and communication campaigns.
In alignment with Arup’s Strategy and Integrated Business Plan, is responsible for increasing brand visibility within region to drive business growth across all media platforms. 
Ensures all creative outputs align with Arup’s brand guidelines and maintain brand consistency across all channels and content types.

Digital Marketing & Social Media

Advises on digital marketing and social media element of integrated marketing and communication campaigns, monitoring results to optimize performance and report campaign outcomes.
Champions continued evolution and maturity in Arup's use of the full capability of our marketing automation platform and ensures cohesion and integration with regional marketing objectives, plans and campaigns.
Responsible for the region’s web content lifecycle plan, ensures that regional web content is aligned with brand guidelines and optimized for search engines.
Responsible for the region’s preference center campaigns to ensure alignment to GDPR, CASL, NPP or similar data privacy regulations as relevant to the jurisdiction.

Qualifications And Accreditations

Undergraduate or further degree or postgraduate professional qualification in communications, journalism, marketing, digital marketing or business management
Membership of a relevant professional body [PRSA, CPSM]

Knowledge And Experience

10+ years proven experience in digital marketing, brand management, and communications.
Knowledge of current trends and developments in communications, particularly in strategy, reputation management, and application of digital tools and techniques.
Strong understanding of digital analytics, SEO/SEM, paid media, and content marketing.
Significant, proven experience in strategic communications and proven track record in several of the following areas: communications strategy and planning, crisis communications, leadership communications and/or internal communications.
Demonstrated experience in leading a large team in an international business and in applying business partnering models across a range of communications specialisms.
Demonstrated experience in building trusted, influential relationships with senior internal and external stakeholders.
Demonstrated experience in building, managing and reporting on budgets.
Experience in leading change, innovation and operational excellence within MCBD functions.

Skills And Attributes

Strong skills in strategic thinking and analysis and problem-solving.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in communications technologies.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment across multiple time zones and adaptable to changing requirements. Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
Comfortable with high levels of ambiguity, particularly in the context of matrix organizational structures.
Able to build strong and highly collaborative working relationships with peers, leaders and other stakeholders.
High level of personal integrity, professionalism, and inclusive leadership. Commitment to exemplifying Arup’s aims, particularly those of being a ‘humane organization’, maintaining ‘quality of work’, and ‘straight and honorable dealings’.

You Should Apply If

If you want to drive the evolution of our communications, brand and digital marketing at a moment of significant change, bringing together creativity, technology and insight to strengthen our reputation, deepen engagement and support future growth.
If you aim to lead an integrated global capability, influence senior leadership and transform how we communicate, engage our audiences and build relevance in a rapidly changing world.
If you desire to shape a globally recognized brand, rethink how we communicate and engage digitally, and lead a talented community through the next evolution of marketing and communications.

What We Offer You

At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognizes the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.

We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.

Benefits at Work - At Arup, we have a comprehensive and valuable benefits program that works for our employees and their families while keeping costs low. These benefits provide health and welfare security for you as well as paid time off for rest and renewal. As a member of Arup, everyone shares in our success through a global profit share scheme (payments are dependent on the firm’s financial performance). Our Global Profit Share Plan (paid bi-annually) provides an opportunity for you to share in the success of the Firm. As a valued employee of Arup, you can also choose to participate in our 401(k) plan with up to 10% company match to help you save for your future.

Flexible Working - We believe that flexible arrangements create a more inclusive way of working that supports our diversity and the wellbeing of our people. Options for alternative schedules and the ability to work outside of the office for a portion of your workweek are available.

Hiring Range - The good faith base salary hiring range for this job if performed in Los Angeles is $180,000 to $210,000 per year. This range is commensurate with experience, educational background, and skill level. Benefits are not included in the base salary. Please note hiring ranges for candidates performing work outside of Los Angeles will differ.

Different people, shared values

Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.

Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup.

To understand what to expect next, please visit https://www.arup.com/careers/recruitment-process/

Stay safe online – Arup will never ask for your bank details as part of our recruitment process.

Recruitment Agencies - We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list.

jobs.description:
Company Description
Pierstone Wealth Management is an independent advisory firm dedicated to helping clients build and preserve wealth, offering clear guidance to support long-term financial confidence. The firm focuses on providing personalized strategies that enable clients to pursue life’s full range of possibilities. Financing support, covenant compliance, and investor/lender reporting
Intercompany funding and share capital administration, including transfer agent reconciliation
Support of potential capital and M&A transactions

Tax risk monitoring and planning opportunities

Partner cross-functionally with Investor Relations, Legal, and operations leadership

Maintain disclosure controls and procedures consistent with dual-listed company obligations

Demonstrated experience managing external audit relationships and internal controls frameworks

Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.

Benefits at Work - At Arup, we have a comprehensive and valuable benefits program that works for our employees and their families while keeping costs low. These benefits provide health and welfare security for you as well as paid time off for rest and renewal. As a member of Arup, everyone shares in our success through a global profit share scheme (payments are dependent on the firm’s financial performance). Our Global Profit Share Plan (paid bi-annually) provides an opportunity for you to share in the success of the Firm. As a valued employee of Arup, you can also choose to participate in our 401(k) plan with up to 10% company match to help you save for your future.

Flexible Working - We believe that flexible arrangements create a more inclusive way of working that supports our diversity and the wellbeing of our people. Options for alternative schedules and the ability to work outside of the office for a portion of your workweek are available.

Hiring Range - The good faith base salary hiring range for this job if performed in Los Angeles is $180,000 to $210,000 per year. This range is commensurate with experience, educational background, and skill level. Benefits are not included in the base salary. Please note hiring ranges for candidates performing work outside of Los Angeles will differ.

Different people, shared values

We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.

Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup.

Company Description
Pierstone Wealth Management is an independent advisory firm dedicated to helping clients build and preserve wealth, offering clear guidance to support long-term financial confidence. The firm focuses on providing personalized strategies that enable clients to pursue life’s full range of possibilities. Pierstone operates as a DBA of Sanctuary Securities, Inc. and Sanctuary Advisors, LLC, partnering with these registered entities to deliver both brokerage and advisory services. Securities are offered through Sanctuary Securities, Inc., Member FINRA, SIPC, and advisory services are provided through Sanctuary Advisors, LLC, an SEC Registered Investment Advisor. This structure enables Pierstone to combine independent advice with robust regulatory oversight and professional standards.
Role Description
The Regional Finance Director is a full-time, remote role responsible for overseeing financial planning, analysis, and reporting across a defined region. This position leads regional financial strategy, collaborates with advisory teams to support client-focused decisions, and ensures alignment with firm-wide goals. Daily responsibilities include reviewing financial statements, monitoring performance metrics, preparing financial reports, and providing actionable insights to senior leadership. The Regional Finance Director will also support budgeting and forecasting processes, strengthen internal controls, and partner with cross-functional teams to improve operational efficiency. This role involves mentoring regional staff on financial best practices and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives in a dynamic wealth management environment.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Finance and Financial Planning skills, including experience with regional or multi-unit financial oversight.
Candidates should possess expertise in Financial Statements and Financial Reporting, with the ability to interpret, prepare, and present complex financial data.
Candidates should possess advanced Analytical Skills to evaluate trends, assess risks, and provide clear recommendations to leadership.
Relevant experience in wealth management, financial services, or advisory firms, with knowledge of regulatory and compliance considerations.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; advanced credentials (e.g., CPA, CFA, MBA) are beneficial.
Proficiency in financial modeling, budgeting, and forecasting tools, and comfort working with financial systems and spreadsheets.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to work effectively in a remote environment and collaborate across teams.
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and influence stakeholders, while maintaining high ethical standards and sound judgment.

new_jobs.description:
Director of Finance, Corporate Controller

DEFSEC Technologies Inc. (NASDAQ / TSXV: DFSC)

Location:
Ottawa (Kanata), Ontario, Canada
Department:
Finance & Accounting
Employment Type:
Full-Time, Permanent
Salary Range:
$160,000 – $200,000 CAD

About DEFSEC Technologies:

DEFSEC Technologies Inc. is an Ottawa-based defence and security company that develops and delivers next-generation technology for military and first responders. The company is proudly Canadian and provides Dismounted/Mounted Domain Expertise in Command-and-Control software development, integration, and support services.

Position Summary:

DEFSEC is seeking an experienced Director of Finance, Corporate Controller to lead the company's core accounting operations, internal controls, treasury, and tax functions across a multi-jurisdictional, internationally operating business with outsourced manufacturing. Reporting to the CFO, this individual will own the general ledger, technical accounting, internal controls (alongside the Director of Financial Reporting and FP&A), audit management, treasury, and tax functions, and will oversee accounting for outsourced manufacturing and international operations across multiple legal entities. This role is expected to drive greater efficiency in day-to-day accounting operations, evolving the finance function into a scalable, value-added business partner rather than a purely transactional back office. This is a senior role suited to a hands-on finance professional comfortable operating in a fast-paced, publicly traded, regulated environment with cross-border operations.

Key Responsibilities:

Financial Reporting, Internal Controls & Audit Management:

Own overall accountability for the preparation and integrity of consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS
Ensure compliance with applicable Canadian securities requirements (including NI 51-102) and SEC reporting obligations
Manage relationships with external auditors and lead year-end and interim audit/review processes, including provision of supporting schedules and evidence
Own and continuously improve the internal controls environment (ICFR) and related SOX-aligned documentation alongside the Director of Financial Reporting and FP&A
Prepare technical accounting positions and disclosure documents

Accounting Operations:

Lead day-to-day accounting operations including general ledger, accounts payable/receivable, payroll compliance, revenue recognition, and month-end/quarter-end close across multiple jurisdictions
Oversee technical accounting positions on complex or non-routine transactions (e.g., revenue contracts, stock-based compensation, business combinations, foreign currency and multi-currency consolidation)
Manage intercompany accounting and eliminations across multiple legal entities
Establish and maintain accounting policies and procedures consistent with a dual-listed public company operating in multiple jurisdictions
Drive continuous improvement of accounting processes, systems, and controls to increase efficiency, reduce close cycle time, and eliminate manual/repetitive work
Identify and implement automation, process standardization, and system opportunities to support a scalable, value-added finance organization
Build finance capabilities that shift the team's focus from purely transactional processing toward business partnering and decision support

Manufacturing & Outsourced Operations Accounting:

Own accounting and cost controls for DEFSEC's outsourced/contract manufacturing model, including inventory accounting, purchase commitments, and vendor cost verification
Partner with Supply Chain/Operations on cost accounting related to contract manufacturing partners across jurisdictions
Support financial due diligence on outsourced manufacturing partners in coordination with Legal and Supply Chain/Operations
Work closely with legal, compliance, and program teams to ensure financial processes appropriately account for defense sector regulatory considerations (e.g., ITAR/EAR-related cost segregation, government contract accounting requirements) across international manufacturing and distribution arrangements
Escalate matters with potential export control, customs, or government contracting compliance implications to Legal/Compliance rather than resolving unilaterally

Treasury & Share Capital:

Support treasury and share capital activities, including:
Cash management, liquidity forecasting, and FX exposure
Financing support, covenant compliance, and investor/lender reporting
Intercompany funding and share capital administration, including transfer agent reconciliation
Support of potential capital and M&A transactions

Tax:

Support tax activities, including:
Income tax and indirect tax compliance and planning, with external advisors
Transfer pricing and tax provision support
Tax risk monitoring and planning opportunities

Team Leadership:

Build, mentor, and manage a high-performing finance team
Set priorities, review work product, and develop staff capabilities as the organization scales
Own and manage the finance department's operating budget, including headcount and resourcing decisions
Partner cross-functionally with Investor Relations, Legal, and operations leadership

Corporate Governance & Disclosure:

Support the CFO and Audit Committee with quarterly and annual reporting cycles
Maintain disclosure controls and procedures consistent with dual-listed company obligations
Handle all financial information, including any material non-public information, with appropriate confidentiality and in accordance with insider trading and selective disclosure policies
Act as a fiduciary of the company, exercising sound, independent judgment in the best interests of DEFSEC and its shareholders in all financial decision-making

Qualifications:

Required:

CPA designation (Canadian) required; US CPA a strong asset
10+ years progressive accounting/finance experience, including prior Controller or Assistant Controller experience at a publicly traded company
Deep working knowledge of IFRS; familiarity with US GAAP/SEC reporting requirements an asset
Experience with dual-listed or cross-border (Canada/US) reporting environments strongly preferred
Demonstrated experience managing accounting and consolidation across multiple legal entities and jurisdictions, spanning North America and international operations
Demonstrated experience managing external audit relationships and internal controls frameworks
Direct experience with treasury functions (cash management, banking relationships, FX exposure) and corporate tax compliance (including transfer pricing and multi-jurisdictional tax matters)
Strong people leadership and team-building track record
Eligible to be vetted as part of the Controlled Goods Program (CGP).

Preferred:

Prior experience in the defense, aerospace, government contracting, or public safety sectors
Familiarity with export control regimes (ITAR/EAR) as they relate to financial and cost accounting practices
Experience accounting for outsourced/contract manufacturing arrangements, including inventory and vendor cost oversight
Experience consolidating financial results across multiple legal entities and subsidiaries in different jurisdictions, including intercompany eliminations and multi-currency consolidation
Experience with ERP systems used in manufacturing or project-based/contract accounting environments
Public company experience with both TSXV and NASDAQ/SEC reporting regimes
Track record of driving process improvement, automation, or efficiency initiatives within an accounting/finance organization

Key Competencies:

High integrity and sound judgment in handling sensitive and confidential financial information
Strong technical accounting acumen paired with pragmatic, business-oriented communication
Ability to operate effectively in a lean, fast-growing organization while maintaining public-company rigor
Clear, professional written and verbal communication with internal and external stakeholders

How to Apply:

If you have a strong passion for this role and are eager to join the dynamic team at DEFSEC, we invite you to submit your resume to employment@defsectec.com. Please make sure to emphasize your pertinent experience and any certifications you hold.

DEFSEC is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, disability or any other protected status under applicable law. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to creating a work environment that is inclusive and welcoming to all, including LGBTQ2S+ individuals. Our hiring decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. In every step of the interview procedure, DEFSEC is committed to providing accommodations.

Exciting opportunity for an experienced finance leader who has worked in the construction and/or restoration sector. Working with an entrepreneurial and dynamic company going through a significant period of growth and transformation. Leading an accounting & finance team of over 10 people and working closely with the CEO/Founder, the Board, and a Fractional CFO.

Who- the Company:

This construction & restoration company has been around for a couple decades and has a robust business portfolio with a diversified customer base. The company has a tight-knit corporate culture with a family feel and entrepreneurial spirit, and many people have been with the company for a long time. The company is stable and successful, but they don’t want to rest on their laurels… the senior leadership has put a strategy in place to continue to grow the business in the coming years, through M&A, new construction offerings, improved processes, modernized systems, and better financial planning & analysis.

What- the Role:

On behalf of our client, Swim Recruiting is seeking a Director of Finance
who will be the organization’s senior finance leader, responsible for the overall financial health, reporting, planning, and performance of the business. This is a broad and hands-on leadership role spanning both strategic finance and day-to-day accounting & financial operations.
The new Director of Finance will report to the CEO and work very closely with a fractional CFO. Leading a Controller and an overall Accounting & Finance team of over 12 people (in Corporate Accounting, Operational & Project Accounting, AR & Collections, AP & Invoicing, Payroll, etc.). The company uses Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central as their primary financial system, as well as Jet Reports (which integrates with Dynamics ERP. The company is also progressive with their use of AI and other modern technologies to aid automation and efficiency. The Director will work closely with executive leadership, the Board, and various operational teams to translate financial information into actionable business insights, ensure strong financial discipline, and support the organization’s continued growth.

What- The Responsibilities:

Accounting & Financial Reporting:
Oversee month-end/quarter-end/year-end close, financial statements, management reporting, internal controls, tax planning & tax compliance, and the organization’s overall financial governance.
FP&A & Business Partnering:
Lead budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling, variance analysis, and performance reporting, providing meaningful insights to support business decisions and drive profitability.
Cash Flow & Treasury:
Oversee cash flow forecasting and reporting, working capital management, liquidity planning, banking relationships, and lender reporting.
Board & Executive Reporting:
Prepare and present financial results, forecasts, budgets, and key performance indicators to the Board and Senior Leadership Team.
Systems & Process Improvement:
Strengthen the company’s financial systems and reporting capabilities and improve processes, controls, automation, and scalability across the finance function.
Team Leadership:
Mentor, manage, and support a collaborative and motivated accounting & finance team of 10+ people.

We are seeking a well-rounded finance leader who combines strong technical expertise with strategic thinking, business savvy, and excellent leadership skills. Qualified candidates will have proven experience in both accounting and FP&A and will be highly capable with financial systems and process improvements. We are looking for people who are comfortable operating both strategically and operationally, and who enjoy partnering with Senior Leadership while building a strong and cohesive finance team.
